method: 576 isolated 30Hz canonical fire/movement/flight/collision comparisons. Prepared center-line shots with standard 60-unit ammunition. Public-motion predictor gets ideal immediate display; response plus full RTT delay precedes steering. This is an optimistic mechanical model, not human recognition, actual browser input delivery, bot hit-rate or fun validation. Global launch velocity is scaled only inside each disposable simulation. Lifetime, drag, damage formula, injury, movement and KO rules stay as coded; resulting impact-damage/range changes are retained for inspection. Windup is rejected and is not tested.
